# Leora B.H.

> > Leora B.H. provides comprehensive behavioral health and addiction treatment services in Ohio, specializing in evidence-based therapies including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Dialectical Behavioral Therapy, and Medication Assisted Treatment.

Leora B.H. serves communities across Ohio, including Columbus and Dayton, offering multiple levels of care from Intensive Outpatient Programs to Partial Hospitalization Programs. The organization provides resources for addiction recovery, mental health treatment, and specialized support for conditions like fetal alcohol syndrome, with a focus on personalized recovery plans and ongoing alumni support.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT)
- Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT)
- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
- Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP)
- 12-Step Therapy
- Fetal Alcohol Syndrome (FAS/FASD)
- Addiction Recovery
- Mental Health Treatment
- Ohio Recovery Resources
- Adolescent Substance Abuse
- Addiction Support Groups (AA/NA)
- Relapse Prevention
- Family Therapy
- Alumni Recovery Programs
